# Jubilees Chapter 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham Teaches Isaac How to Worship

---

**21:1** In the sixth year of the seventh week of the forty-second jubilee, Abraham called his son Isaac and gave him these instructions:

**21:2** "I'm old now, and I don't know how much time I have left. I'm one hundred and seventy-five years old — I've had a full life.

**21:3** Every day I've lived, I've kept the LORD in my thoughts and sought with everything I had to do what he wanted and walk his path. I turned my back on idols and rejected everyone who serves them. I dedicated myself, heart and soul, to knowing his will.

**21:4** My soul despises idols. I have no use for those who worship them. My heart belongs to the LORD God.

**21:5** So, my son — you keep his commands, his laws, his judgments. Don't go chasing after idols, carved images, or cast figures.

**21:6** Never eat blood — animal or bird — as long as you live. Never eat animal fat. The blood is the life-force, and the fat is the glory.

**21:7** Don't eat the blood — pour it on the altar instead. Offer all the fat on the altar. Every firstborn male from your herds and flocks belongs to the LORD your God; consecrate them to him.

**21:8** Every firstborn from your livestock you set apart for the LORD. Eat it at the sanctuary — wherever he chooses to put his name.

**21:9** Every tenth animal from your herds and flocks that passes under the counting rod is holy to the LORD — that tenth is his.

**21:10** Offer the fat and the blood on the altar. The meat you eat in the holy place.

**21:11** Everything you sacrifice on the altar must be completely burned — don't leave any of it until morning. Build the altar from uncut stones — no iron tools, no shaped stones. Keep it natural.

**21:12** Morning and evening, offer a whole burnt offering there, along with the grain offering and incense. In the morning, burn frankincense. In the evening, burn aromatic spices and incense — a sweet smell — and offer your peace offerings.

**21:13** All the fat from the peace offerings goes on the altar: the fat around the intestines, the liver, the kidneys, the fat covering both kidneys, and the fat on the flanks and diaphragm — all of it removed.

**21:14** Put it all on the altar. It's a fire offering — an offering pleasing to the LORD. Give your peace offerings to the LORD your God honestly and fully.

**21:15** Salt every offering. Never let the salt go missing from your offerings before the LORD — it's the salt of the covenant.

**21:16** For altar wood, be careful to use only these approved kinds: cypress, pine, almond, fir, cedar, juniper, fig, olive, myrtle, laurel, aspalathus, and balsam.

**21:17** Burn only these kinds under the altar fire. Test them each before you use them, and never substitute anything else — each of these gives off a pleasing smell before the LORD.

**21:18** Of all the trees in the world, these fourteen are the only ones to use under the altar's burnt offering.

**21:19** Above all — guard your life and keep away from blood. God will hold you accountable for every life — animal or human.

**21:20** Blood shed on the earth cries out before the LORD, and the only thing that purifies the land from shed blood is the blood of the one who shed it.

**21:21** Don't take a payoff in exchange for someone's blood — don't let murder go unpunished for money. Human blood demands justice, and those who shed it will face the LORD's righteous judgment.

**21:22** Son — before you approach the altar, wash your hands and your feet. Once you've washed, don't let any blood stay on them.

**21:23** Offer your burnt offerings and peace offerings faithfully. Keep the altar fire going — it must never go out. Morning and evening, bring your offerings and burn incense.

**21:24** Isaac said, "Father, I'll do everything you've said. But I'm nervous to ask you something — I don't want you to be upset with me."

**21:25** Abraham said, "Ask anything — I'll answer you." Isaac said, "When you're gone, how am I supposed to do all this? I don't know how to make the offerings correctly."

**21:26** Abraham said, "I've already written it all down for you — the entire law, all the statutes and ordinances I received from the LORD on Mount Sinai through the angel of the presence. It's all there in the book of the first law. You'll have everything you need."

---
*PNEUMA notes: The altar-wood list (vv.16-18) is unique to Jubilees — 14 permitted species. The scene ends with a touching exchange: Isaac's vulnerability, Abraham's reassurance. Abraham's claim to possess the Mosaic law already reflects Jubilees' theology of eternal pre-existing law.*
